message: Hey John, did you hear about Mr. Stanton? I overheard that he's been seeing someone outside his marriage. This could be why everyone's on edge lately, and it's definitely impacting team morale.

I think the team morale is a bit low because of all the rumors flying around about Mr. Stanton's affair. We should probably try to keep the team focused on the work and not let personal matters of our boss affect our project deadlines.
